maya-cs: Quick weekly check-in for Horizon Labs private VPC (eu-west / us-central). Noticed a KMS error uptick in eu-west yesterday around 03:10 UTC. Sharing what we have so we can triage.
liam-ops: Saw the spike — error rate ~0.9% between 03:10-03:25 UTC. I restarted the KM proxy once, seemed to momentarily drop. Logs attached below.
olga-se: Also seeing intermittent 503s from the LB in us-central during burst traffic (around 03:18). Might be autoscale lag + cold workers.
sanjay-ctm: Heads up — customer mentioned latency in renewal call. They asked for an RCA and ETA. We should surface impact and mitigation plan.
kira-support: Ran KMS key checks: no scheduled rotations. HSM latency p90 eu-west ~120ms over that window. Not huge but coincides with errors.
heartbeat-bot: HorizonLabs-private-vpc-eu-west: uptime 99.982% last 24h. Degraded window 03:10-03:27 UTC (incident inc-2026-047).
liam-ops: Actionable items: 1) Opened infra bridge with Horizon infra team, pinged on their side. 2) I'll adjust autoscale cooldown to 30s and bump request timeout to 6s for canary.
maya-cs: Usage note: tokens/min jumped from ~850 -> ~2400 for a ~10min window during the incident. I'll add that to the weekly account health summary and flag renewal risk.
olga-se: Pushed a canary update with improved KMS retry policy (3s exponential backoff). Monitoring for next 6 hours.
sanjay-ctm: I'll coordinate with AE to offer temporary credits if impact breaches SLA. Need a short customer-facing blurb. Can someone draft?
kira-support: Relevant log snippet: ```ERR kms_client.go:142 rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = connection closed by peer``` — appears correlated with HF gateway resets.
liam-ops: :thumbsup: I'll own follow-up. Will post a status update in this thread in 2 hours with canary telemetry.
maya-cs: Thanks — please include p95 latency and error-rate delta for both regions in the update. Also capture any KMS/HSM stack traces we can share with their infra team.
olga-se: Noted. If canary looks good after 6h, we'll propose the retry policy + autoscale change as a permanent config for their Dedicated pool.
heartbeat-bot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance window for regional HSM provider in eu-west on 2026-06-15 02:00-03:00 UTC. Might affect future windows. :information_source:
liam-ops: Aiming to close loop by EOD. If anything new, drop it here and I'll re-open bridge.
maya-cs: Great, appreciate it. I'll prepare the renewal-facing summary once you post the telemetry.
